faqs.question: courses
faqs.answer: Our college offers B.Tech in CSE, ECE, ME and Civil programs.

faqs.question: admission
faqs.answer: Admissions are based on the state entrance exam followed by centralized counselling. Check the official portal for dates.

faqs.question: timetable
faqs.answer: The timetable is updated every semester and is available on the college website → Academics → Timetable.

faqs.question: placements
faqs.answer: The average placement rate is ~80% with recruiters including Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Accenture, and startups.

faqs.question: library
faqs.answer: Library hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–7:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM–1:00 PM. Closed on Sundays and holidays.

faqs.question: exam schedule
faqs.answer: Mid-semester and end-semester exam schedules are published by the Exam Cell. Watch the Notices section.

faqs.question: hostel
faqs.answer: Separate hostels for boys and girls with mess facilities. Contact the Hostel Office for vacancy and fee details.

faqs.question: scholarship
faqs.answer: Merit and need-based scholarships are offered. See the Scholarships page for eligibility and deadlines.

faqs.question: contact
faqs.answer: General Helpdesk: +91-XXXXXXXXXX, Email: info@college.edu (replace with official contacts).

faqs.question: hod or head of the department
What are the canteen timings?
faqs.answer: The college canteen is open from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM on working days.

faqs.question: What is the admission process?
faqs.answer: Admissions are based on entrance exam scores and an interview.

faqs.question: Where is the library located?
faqs.answer: The library is in Block B, second floor.

faqs.question: What are the hostel fees?
faqs.answer: Hostel fees are Rs. 60,000 per year including food and maintenance.
